result.brief: 提出解耦的游戏世界模型 WorldMind，将交互世界建模分为理解、决策、控制与生成四层，从生成帧构建紧凑状态以支撑状态感知的 NPC 行为，并发布 BOSS-140K 数据集。
result.reason: Decoupled game world model with understanding/decision/control/generation layers and compact state representation from generated frames; contributes to world modeling and state-aware interactive prediction.
